rule.title: Schedule E line 6 takes 50% of meals while traveling for the rental

when_missing.because: Taken as no unless a preparer says so: Is this item a meal eaten while traveling away from home for the rental activity?

citation.wording: You can deduct ordinary and necessary auto and travel expenses related to your rental activities, including 50% of meal expenses incurred while traveling away from home.

rule.open_point: Only the meals half is applied. The standard mileage rate (miles x 70 cents) is a computation from a mileage count, and the choice between actual expenses and the standard rate is the preparer's.
